title: IRS Transcript Weekly Processing Days Trend
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=irs:transcript processing_days=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(processing_days) as avg_duration, max(processing_days) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst processing days for IRS transcript events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture processing_days on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average processing days with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether IRS transcript tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
